reason: I buy Semtex or Monster 4-packs on offer and I count the price per can. 55 CZK for 330 ml costs more than a Red Bull and more than a big Monster that's half again the size, so I'd just keep grabbing my 4-pack on Rohlík.
objection: It costs more per can and per ml than what I already drink, and 'cleaner' and 'natural' aren't worth paying extra for when caffeine is caffeine to me.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack deal on Rohlík that brings it down to around 35 CZK a can, cheaper than Red Bull.
